![横幅](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Moogs_Soaring_Structure/BH_MSS_header.webp) [![Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/D1D8LKA5N) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/869218732650688543?color=14822e&label=DISCORD&style=for-the-badge)](https://discord.com/invite/S5nffJbuvA) [![CurseForge 项目](https://img.shields.io/badge/CurseForge-projects-14822e?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge)](https://www.curseforge.com/members/finndog_123/projects) [![Modrinth 项目](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-projects-14822e?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/user/FinnDog_123) [![查看结构](https://pub-24a4e0e7ea8544a5b6f73c3a23512589.r2.dev/images/c110cc09347a4f9f9de6c974f2fa35d8.png)](https://previews.moogsmods.com/soaring-structures/1.21.1/) ![概览](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Moogs_Soaring_Structure/BH_MSS_overview.webp) 本模组支持 Forge、Fabric、NeoForge 和 Quilt！也仅需安装在服务端即可使用。 Forge 支持已在 1.20.4 版本后停止。 ### 关于 Moogs Soaring Structures 为你的 Minecraft 世界注入生机、乐趣与多样性，添加了众多浮空岛屿及精美建筑以供探索！使用原版方块和实体打造令人惊叹的新结构，沿途发现宝藏、敌人和村民。本模组兼容任何整合包，甚至可仅安装于服务端！ [![3D预览所有结构](https://pub-24a4e0e7ea8544a5b6f73c3a23512589.r2.dev/images/f8fe835413394a76b10a678afefea30f.png)](https://previews.moogsmods.com/soaring-structures/1.21.1/) 如需查看部分结构，请访问[预览网站](https://previews.moogsmods.com/soaring-structures/1.21.1/)。 [![MinecraftStorage](https://imgur.com/ApCtgr7.png)](https://minecraftstorage.com/mods/mss-moogs-soaring-structures) ### 配置包 模组的每个方面均可通过数据包自定义。包含完整说明的模板可在此[查看](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/mss-moogs-soaring-structure-config-pack)。 ![特性](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Moogs_Soaring_Structure/BH_MSS_features.webp) ![拼贴图](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1040210/description_84b68622-1f45-4dd0-b110-ff18e67252ac.png) ### 视频
### 整合包 所有整合包请[点击此处](https://www.modpackindex.com/modpack/finder?included_mods=61020)查看。 ![横幅](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Moogs_Soaring_Structure/BH_MSS_discord.webp) 获取回复最快的方式是加入我们的 [Discord 服务器](https://discord.gg/S5nffJbuvA)。 [![BH赞助](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Moogs_Soaring_Structure/BH_MSS_promo.webp)](https://bisecthosting.com/moogsmods?r=mrss)
